name: bb-plugin-voice-concierge
description: bb plugin: talk to bb hands-free. A realtime voice concierge that sees your threads and answers aloud, in its own conversation or with the thread you call from.

bb.name: Voice Concierge
bb.description: Talk to bb out loud: ask what is running, what needs you, what a thread concluded, or press Talk in any thread to talk to that thread's agent. A realtime voice agent (Codex, on your ChatGPT plan) answers aloud; changes wait for your spoken yes.
